title: Extending Reasoning in Typed Decision Models via Looping
abstract: arXiv:2611.07736v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed decision models choose among a fixed set of answer options in a single forward pass, so unlike generative language models they cannot spend more test-time compute on hard inputs by generating more tokens. Looping a block of layers offers this compute in latent space without adding parameters, but prior work found no gain from loops retrofitted into conventionally pretrained models. We show that such loops help when trained together with the decision model. Our method, RELOAD (retrofitted loops for adaptive decisions), fine-tunes a pretrained encoder or decoder with a damped loop over its middle block and a lightweight controller picks the number of passes adaptively for each input. Across six models from 0.4B to 4B parameters, looping improves both accuracy and calibration, mostly on problems that need longer chains of reasoning than any seen in training, where encoders gain up to 23 points. translated_title: 通过循环机制扩展类型化决策模型的推理能力
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型在单次前向传播中从固定的答案选项集合中进行选择，因此与生成式语言模型不同，它们无法通过生成更多 token 来在困难输入上投入更多的测试时计算量。对一层块进行循环可以在不增加参数的情况下在潜空间中提供这种额外计算，但先前的工作发现，将循环改装到按常规方式预训练的模型中并未带来收益。我们证明，当这种循环与决策模型一起训练时才能发挥作用。我们的方法 RELOAD（用于自适应决策的改装循环）对预训练的编码器或解码器进行微调，在其中间块上采用阻尼循环，并由一个轻量级控制器为每个输入自适应地选择循环次数。在从 0.4B 到 4B 参数的六个模型上，循环机制提升了准确性和校准度，提升主要体现在那些需要比训练中见过的任何问题都更长的推理链的问题上，编码器在此类问题上最多可获得 23 分的提升。无论是匹配的训练计算量还是……（原文摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RELOAD 方法，通过对预训练模型的中间块进行阻尼循环并由轻量级控制器自适应选择循环次数，首次证明循环机制在与决策模型联合训练时能显著提升类型化决策模型的准确性与校准度，尤其在需要长推理链的问题上编码器最多可提升 23 分。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RELOAD, which fine-tunes pretrained models with a damped loop over their middle block and a lightweight adaptive controller, showing for the first time that looping helps when trained jointly with typed decision models—improving accuracy and calibration, especially on problems requiring longer reasoning chains, with encoders gaining up to 23 points.
